Welcome!


 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 

 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 


 

The Howard County Board of Supervisors and all of the individual County Departments would like to Welcome you to the Howard County Government website. 
 
The purpose of this site is to extend our Courthouse and many of its public services onto the internet and into your home or office. It is our desire to provide our services in an efficient and convenient manner to the citizens of Howard County, and interestsoutside Howard County, 24 hours a day/7 days a week/365 days a year. 
 
It is our intent that the site will continue to grow and evolve, offering services and information to benefit the citizens of Howard County beyond business, with links to local government and local organization web sites, this site is a window highlighting Howard County, its communities, and its people.
